title: Long-Standing Policyholder Salvage Discount on Kept Vehicles, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
Cardinal Mutual discounts the salvage deduction for long-standing policyholders who keep a total-loss vehicle under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, measured by the inception date of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy.

**Terms.** Where the auto policy's inception date is at least 120 whole months before the loss date, the salvage deduction is the salvage value less 20 percent; where it is at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before, the salvage deduction is the salvage value less 10 percent; otherwise the salvage deduction is the salvage value. The discounted figure is rounded to the cent.

The salvage value here is the salvage figure taken against the kept-vehicle settlement before this discount. Whole months are complete calendar months from the inception date to the loss date; the inception date is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record and the loss date from the claim's loss report.

| Whole months from inception to the loss date | Salvage deduction |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | Salvage value less 20 percent |
| 60 to 119 | Salvage value less 10 percent |
| Fewer than 60 | Salvage value |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical figures, salvage value 2500.00)

- 120 whole months: 2500.00 less 20 percent gives 2000.00.
- 119 whole months: 2500.00 less 10 percent gives 2250.00.
- 60 whole months: 2250.00.
- 59 whole months: 2500.00.
- Salvage value 3333.33 at 60 whole months: less 10 percent gives 2999.997, rounded to 3000.00.
